name: use-file-upload
title: useFileUpload
description: Hook for managing file uploads with presigned URLs, progress tracking, and file state.

docs.lead: A React hook that manages file uploads with GCS presigned URLs via Uppy. Handles progress tracking, retry logic, file state management, and provides dropzone integration helpers.
docs.usage:
import { useFileUpload } from "@/hooks/use-file-upload"

const upload = useFileUpload({
  endpoint: '/api/assets/pre-signed',
  providerId: workspace.id,
  assetType: 'attachment',
  headers: () => ({ Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }),
})

examples.title: Document Upload with Dropzone
examples.description: Combine useFileUpload with FileUpload.Dropzone and FileCard.Item to create a full upload experience with minimal boilerplate.

examples.title: Logo Upload
examples.description: Pair useFileUpload with LogoUpload.Item for a complete logo upload experience with avatar preview.

api.name: useFileUpload Options
api.description: Configuration options passed to the hook.

props.name: endpoint
props.description: The API endpoint for obtaining presigned upload URLs (e.g. '/api/assets/pre-signed').

props.name: baseUrl
props.description: Base URL prepended to the endpoint.

props.name: headers
props.description: Function returning headers for the presigned URL request (e.g. auth tokens).

props.name: providerId
props.description: The provider/workspace ID sent to the presigned URL endpoint.

props.name: assetType
props.description: The asset type sent to the presigned URL endpoint (matches backend AssetType enum).

props.name: acl
props.description: Access control level for the uploaded file.

props.name: maxFiles
props.description: Maximum number of files allowed.

props.name: maxFileSize
props.description: Maximum file size in bytes (default 5MB).

props.name: allowedFileTypes
props.description: Allowed MIME types or file extensions.

props.name: onUploadSuccess
props.description: Called when a file upload completes successfully.

props.name: onUploadError
props.description: Called when a file upload fails.

props.name: onFileRemove
props.description: Called when a file is removed from the list.

props.name: onRestrictionFailed
props.description: Called when a file fails an upload restriction (e.g. maxFileSize).

api.name: useFileUpload Return Value
api.description: The object returned by the hook.

props.name: files
props.description: Array of all files with their current upload state.

props.name: isUploading
props.description: True if any file is currently uploading.

props.name: isDraggingOver
props.description: True when a file is being dragged over the dropzone (via getRootProps).

props.name: addFiles
props.description: Add native File objects to the upload queue.

props.name: removeFile
props.description: Remove a file by ID. Cancels upload if in progress.

props.name: retryFile
props.description: Retry a failed upload by re-adding the original file.

props.name: clearFiles
props.description: Remove all files and revoke preview URLs.

props.name: openFilePicker
props.description: Programmatically open the native file picker dialog.

props.name: getInputProps
props.description: Returns props to spread on a hidden <input type="file">.

props.name: getRootProps
props.description: Returns drag event handlers to spread on a dropzone container. Tracks isDraggingOver state internally.

api.name: UploadFile
api.description: The file state object tracked by the hook.

props.name: id
props.description: Unique file identifier (from Uppy).

props.name: name
props.description: Original file name.

props.name: size
props.description: File size in bytes.

props.name: type
props.description: MIME type.

props.name: progress
props.description: Upload progress from 0 to 100.

props.name: status
props.description: Current upload status.

props.name: url
props.description: Public URL after successful upload.

props.name: key
props.description: GCS storage path/key.

props.name: preview
props.description: Object URL for image file previews (revoked on removal).

props.name: error
props.description: Error message if upload failed.
